info.title: Cura AI API
info.description:
Backend for **Cura AI**, a chronic-disease follow-up prioritisation demo. **All data is synthetic.**

* Risk scores are *simulated predictions* produced by batch scoring runs with the saved model bundle.
  They are never recomputed when a page is opened.
* Every payload labels its provenance: `simulated_prediction`, `recorded_synthetic_clinical`,
  `recorded_synthetic_outcome` or `recorded_outreach_outcome`.
* **Authentication:** `AUTH_MODE=supabase` verifies Supabase Auth access tokens
  (`Authorization: Bearer ...`) and maps them to provisioned `app_users` roles (`coordinator`,
  `analyst`, `admin`). `AUTH_MODE=dev` (local only, refused in production) accepts `X-Dev-User` /
  `X-Dev-Role` headers.
* Errors have the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.

OutreachHistoryIn.description:
A historical outreach attempt: the same rules as recording outreach, plus its programme and a
required attempt time.

submission_id.description: Client-generated UUID; resubmitting the same id never creates a second patient

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: Calibrated probability that follow-up is still incomplete 30 days after the due date

ScoreContext.title: ScoreContext
ScoreContext.description:
How to read a score for this episode at the data cutoff (`as_of`).

* follow_up_status — recorded state of the follow-up: upcoming (before due date),
  due_in_grace_window (past due, 30-day completion window still open), overdue_unresolved (not
  completed by the end of the window: an observed outcome needing operational follow-up),
  completed, censored, not_eligible.
* score_status — predictive (outcome not yet known, so the probability is a live prediction),
  historical (the outcome window has closed or the episode is resolved; the probability is a past
  prediction kept for provenance), no_score.
